_readme: FILL THIS IN, THEN REPLACE EVERY {{TOKEN}} IN THE SITE WITH ITS VALUE. Apply across all .html files + site.js + sitemap.xml + robots.txt. Values below are EXAMPLES for a fictional dental clinic — overwrite them all.

identity.KEYWORDS: dentist, emergency dentist, teeth cleaning, root canal, teeth whitening

branding._note: Pack default accent. Overridden per prospect by the logo-derived brandColors.primary (RAW_JSON on agencyProspect); null primary keeps this default.

hero.HERO_LEDE: Serving Springfield and surrounding communities with comfortable, modern dental care since 2005. Same-day emergencies, honest pricing, and beautiful smiles.

services.SERVICE_1_DESC: Comprehensive exams, x-rays, and professional teeth cleaning.
services.SERVICE_2_DESC: Severe toothaches, broken teeth, and lost crowns — we see you immediately.
services.SERVICE_3_DESC: Professional teeth whitening, veneers, and bonding.
services.SERVICE_4_DESC: Painless root canal therapy to save infected teeth.
services.SERVICE_5_DESC: Permanent, natural-looking replacements for missing teeth.
services.SERVICE_6_DESC: Clear aligners and traditional braces for all ages.

reviews.REVIEW_1_TEXT: Called at 8am for a severe toothache. They squeezed me in within the hour and handled the extraction perfectly. Very professional and clean. Would definitely recommend!
reviews.REVIEW_2_TEXT: We've been bringing our family here for 5 years. Always on time, always professional. The hygienists are incredibly gentle.
reviews.REVIEW_3_TEXT: Got my teeth whitened and fixed a chipped tooth. The process was smooth, they explained everything, and my smile has never looked better.
